name: Johann Nickel Grub
bioAdditions: FamilySearch makes Johann Nickel a son of Johann Peter Grub's first wife, Gretha (Margretha) Catharina, who died before Peter's second marriage on 19 Oct 1694, and not of the second wife, Elisabetha Catharina Jung (S1, S2). The register shows Peter's wife was Gretha Catharina in 1684 and Margretha Catharina in 1687 (see H0078). Nickel's own baptism has not been found; the site has him born about 1694 from his 1707 confirmation. Who his mother was depends on whether he was born before or after October 1694. If after, he would be the Jung wife's first child. FamilySearch gives his burial date as 7 Feb 1763 and attaches a Lutheran burial entry ('Nicolaus Gruben'), whose image came back empty (S1).

conflicts.foundValue: Gretha/Margretha Catharina, first wife, surname unknown, d. before Oct 1694 (FamilySearch); the Jung wife was Elisabetha Catharina, m. 19 Oct 1694
conflicts.assessment: Needs Nickel's baptism (Reichenbach Lutheran register, c.1693-95). See H0078.
